Mind Citadel: Quiz RPG Adventure 
Turn knowledge into power

⚔️ Mind Citadel combines challenging trivia with dark fantasy RPG progression. Answer thousands of questions, collect legendary gear, build your kingdom, and climb the global leaderboard. Whether you enjoy quiz games or RPG adventures, there’s always something new to conquer in the realm of Mind Citadel. 

 MORE THAN JUST A QUIZ GAME

Test yourself with 10,256 trivia questions across 10 categories:

 🎵Music
 🎬Movies
 📖Literature
 🌍Geography
 🔢Mathematics
 📜History
 🔬Science
 🦊Nature
 ⚽Sport
 🎨Art


KEY FEATURES
- Medieval dark fantasy theme with original music
- 10,256 questions with explanations and fun facts
- 10 buildings with 20 specializations and an idle gold income
- 54 craftable artifacts across 6 slots and 9 rarities
- Enchantment system with stones and scrolls
- Skill Tree with 31 abilities across 4 branches
- Weekly boss who tests your knowledge
- Arena Weekly Competition
- Conquer the Tower of Knowledges
- Win the global Invasion
- Choose your Faction
- Collect Runes
- Monthly Battle Pass with 30 levels of rewards

🏰 A FULL RPG EXPERIENCE

👑Build your empire. Construct and upgrade 10 buildings, each linked to a different knowledge field. As you progress, unlock powerful specializations that shape your strategy. Your empire keeps growing even while you're away, generating gold for up to 12 hours offline. 
⚔️Craft legendary artifacts. Earn fragments by answering questions and completing expeditions. Turn them into legendary artifacts and equip 6 gear slots: Head, Left Hand, Right Hand, Accessory, Relic, and Companion. Discover unique items across 9 rarity tiers, from Common to Ethereal.
✨ Upgrade and enhance your power. Strengthen your gear with upgrade stones. A reward system ensures your effort always pays off over time.
🪽 Unlock mystical wings. Collect rare feathers to unlock wings that boost your overall progress: from gold and knowledge points to fragment drops, and more.
🌳Climb the Skill Tree. Spend skill points across four branches: Mind, Economy, Crafting, and Magic. With 31 skills available, you can shape your character in your own way.
🧭 Enter the expedition mode. Take on a trivia challenge with 12 increasingly difficult stages. Earn rare rewards like feathers, radiant stones, and scrolls. Plus, a bonus for completing the full run.
🌍 Compete with players worldwide in weekly arena competition.
